decisions.reason: Close to the established offer with its own website page, results likely meet aspirations and slack supports keeping.
Distant from the established offer increases uncertainty, but the firm's slack and expansion allow carrying it while its performance is assessed.
Close to the established offer and launched as a multi-model line, indicating satisfactory results and no reason to search for alternatives.
Building on established offer but only mentioned on the website suggests uncertain traction, yet slack allows keeping it for now.
